title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Theatre on 1976-06-04
lineage: Master Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M) > 1st generation reels (Pioneer RT707 @ 3 3/4 ips); 1st generation reels (Revox A77) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2021 > TLH flac2496
source: Mickey Hart's Master Soundboard Cassettes w/dolby B (Sony TC-152SD) > Steve Martin's 1st generation reels @ 3 3/4 ips

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures the debut of “Mission In The Rain,” but the overall performance is middling with a meandering second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its great sound‑board mix, delivering clear and balanced audio. While the show features a notable debut of Garcia’s solo ballad “Mission In The Rain,” reviewers find the rest of the concert, especially the Help > Slip > Franklin’s sequence, to be lackluster and unfocused.

ai_rating.rationale: The review rates the show a 3‑star average, noting strong recording quality but only moderate musical performance; with one detailed review confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a “great SB mix,” indicating clear, well‑balanced sound with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as more cohesive; second set feels slow and meandering, leading to an overall mediocre concert experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo ballad “Mission In The Rain” highlighted as a favorite.
